title: An Efficient Parity-Blocked Method for Band-Structure Computation of 3D Anisotropic Phononic Crystals
summary: Band-structure calculations for three-dimensional anisotropic phononic crystals require the repeated solution of large elastic generalized eigenvalue problems along Bloch paths. In standard staggered-grid discretizations, anisotropic coupling may involve derivative components located at incompatible grid positions, so additional interpolation or averaging closures are often introduced. This paper proposes a parity-blocked rotated staggered discretization based on four Bloch-periodic body-diagonal differences.
